thunderstorms are possible, especially the second half of the

see activity earlier this evening, and there are some
indications of higher rain totals from storms becoming locked
along the terrain.

will likely lift north of the area Tuesday morning, allowing a
warm and humid airmass to overspread the area. A seasonably
strong trough will be approaching from the west, providing
forcing and at least 30 to 40 kt of shear. This combination
provides a favorable environment for severe thunderstorms, and
it appears the typical afternoon and evening time frame will be
favored for the strongest storms. Some details remain
unresolved, especially the effects of today's upstream
